# Phase 03 — Outcome, Feasibility, Cost and Risk Predictions

Use `outcome-risk-prediction`. No code changes.

Evaluate feasibility and likely outcomes for the proposed architecture. For each major subsystem provide conservative/base/optimistic scenarios, assumptions, confidence and evidence needed. Cover:
- English/Hindi/Hinglish transcription and diarization.
- Long-video chunking, timestamp drift and frame sampling.
- Podcast context and speaker changes.
- Educational explanation completeness.
- Gaming event detection.
- Comedy setup/punchline preservation.
- NVIDIA model/API modality fit, model availability and local GPU requirements.
- Candidate quality vs human editor baseline.
- Rendering throughput and quality.
- Instagram/YouTube OAuth, permissions, API quotas and publishing reliability.
- Cloud/local cost drivers and operational complexity.

Do not invent prices, quotas, GPU compatibility, model limits, throughput or accuracy. Research live official docs where needed; record URL and verification date. For unknown cost, provide a calculation model and benchmark procedure. Create a risk register with probability, impact, mitigation, early warning and owner. Define go/no-go criteria for v1. Stop for design review.


Global rules: Follow `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and the relevant skills. Inspect existing repository state before edits. Do not invent API/model facts. Keep the scope of this prompt only. Do not advance to the next phase automatically. End with a gate report and explicit status.
